name: Son tra wine
summary: Rượu táo mèo is táo mèo fruit wine, poured at the tree stalls under Silver Waterfall and named beside corn wine as a Sa Pa drink.
origin: Sa Pa, at the Silver Waterfall stalls.
howToEat: Drink it with the stall snacks: cơm lam, grilled corn, eggs, and sweet potato.
where: The tree stalls under Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town toward Ô Quy Hồ.
seoTitle: Son tra wine in Sapa — a Silver Waterfall stall
seoDescription: Rượu táo mèo at the tree stalls under Silver Waterfall, with rượu mơ and rượu san lùng.
